verdict.rationale: Vue's docs claim a compiler-optimized, rarely-needs-manual-optimization rendering system and an ecosystem that 'scales between a library and a full-featured framework' with official router/state tools, and some community posts confirm happy large-team adoption. But other hands-on reports concretely contradict the maintainability-at-scale claim: 'Vue is good for simple things... does not shine for complex apps' (vue-comm-8), 'for really complex applications, it's too magical' (vue-comm-19), and repeated notes that TypeScript support is 'mediocre... second class citizen' which 'will be hard for any frontend application to scale properly' (vue-comm-15, vue-comm-17), plus build-tooling pain at scale (vue-comm-16). missing for 10: independent large-scale case studies or benchmarks resolving these contradictions, stronger first-party TS/scale documentation.
